description: An opaque russet knee-to-mid-calf noble tunic has wide gold-toned woven borders, heraldic embroidery at the hem, and broad outer sleeves over a cream long-sleeved undertunic. A dark burgundy cloak attaches with two round clasps linked by a chain. An ornamental brown belt with round medallions and a hanging strap secures the waist. Dark trousers and tall brown leather boots are visible.
